_comment: Purposes the component's JSDoc does not give in a line an agent can pick from. Everything else comes from the JSDoc first sentence; see scripts/generate-ai.cjs.

components.AvatarGroup: Overlapping stack of avatars with a limit and an overflow count
components.Button: Action button with variants, sizes, prefix/suffix icons and a loading state; onPress runs it
components.Card: Pressable surface (onPress), with every Flex prop; a static panel is a Column with background, border and radius instead
components.Checkbox: Checkbox with label and description, including an indeterminate state
components.Dropdown: The bordered surface a menu's Options sit on; DropdownWrapper places it under its trigger
components.DropdownWrapper: A trigger that opens a menu of Options under it (or above when there is no room): row actions, an account menu
components.Heading: A heading, heading-strong-l by default and announced as a header
components.Spinner: Rotating loader for async and streaming states
components.StatusIndicator: Small coloured status dot (online, error, warning) by colour scheme
components.ThemeProvider: Root provider: core's style options with core's defaults (theme, brand, neutral, solid, border, scaling…), plus fonts and the screen's safe-area insets
components.Tooltip: The small surface bubble a hint is drawn in; it shows nothing on its own (InfoTip shows a tip on press)
